The governmental side treats 316,411 as a transfer out, while the utility treats it as an interfund advance being repaid; business_type.transfers_net is 417,859 only. A person should decide whether it stays in transfers_out or becomes other_financing. decision_needed[] does not have this question.

The Statement of Activities (p2) shows Economic development charges for services of 81,411, so at least part of the program income sits in Charges for services rather than Miscellaneous. What the line holds is not determinable from the page, so 'other' is defensible.

The page doesn't say whether the grant is federal or state. The Statement of Activities (p2) puts it under Capital Grants and Contributions (1,495,044 = 1,465,044 + 30,000 capital contributions). This is a judgment call; the line is already marked review.
